## Naming angles

- **A. Descriptive**: what it literally shows (Scattered Paws)
- **B. Evocative**: mood (Midnight Rose)
- **C. Playful**: a joke or a wink (Busy Bees)
- **D. Trade or botanical**: the technical or species name (Echeveria)
- **E. Vintage**: heritage or period register (Cottage Garden)
- **F. Modern**: one or two words, minimal (Clover Field)
